28a96123: If input is a '?', branch to QS (question-mark code). If input starts with '^', execute D (input conversion code) and branch out of DIE.

8ce984bf: If input is a space and DV("D") is true and the DISV("DIE",DLB) node exists for this user, set X to that node's value (stored data value). If DV("D") is false or DV("S") is true, display the value.

46999570: If DV("D") is true, branch to M^DIE17 (word processing code). If DV("V") is true, branch to ^DIE3 (validate input code). If DV("P") is true, execute computed DIC("S") code. If DV("X") is true, execute computed 12.1 node code. Find external match in DU (set of codes) and execute computed DIC("S") code. If match found and DB(DQ) is undefined, display match, else branch to V (edit value code).
ca22d708: If no match found in DU, search DU for each ';' piece. If an internal match is found, execute computed DIC("S") code. Quit if a match is found.
7f248875: If no match found in DU and DB(DQ) is undefined, display remaining external value from DU. Set X to remaining internal value from DU.
